entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... I, uh, I need to make a return. I'm just so disappointed with my purchase.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and the email address on your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's Alex Chen. The email is a.chen@email.com.
Thank you, Alex. I see your recent order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor right here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I guess it's a preference. It's just so... it's really hard to use. The whole interface is very confusing to me. I've read the user manual twice and I still can't get it to do what I want.
I see. I'm sorry it's not feeling intuitive for you.

Yeah, I just expected more, you know? I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time, and I've always loved your products. This one just isn't it. And honestly, I feel terrible about it, but I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.

I completely understand, and we truly appreciate you being a VIP customer, Alex. It's important to us that you're happy with your gear. Let me just check the return eligibility on this for you. One moment.

Alright, thank you for your patience. I've just reviewed our policy. It looks like you received the band 18 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Diana.

Of course. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to your email. Just pack the item in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives it, you'll see the refund processed in about 5-7 business days.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. I was so worried.
Not a problem at all. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
